name: channel-telegram-webhook
title: Telegram by webhook: chat with your agent from the Telegram app, on Cloudflare
description: Talk to your agent in Telegram when it runs on Cloudflare: Telegram posts each message to your Worker.

environment.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
environment.description: The bot's token from @BotFather; `pikit configure` asks for it and checks it.

environment.name: TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USERS
environment.description: Telegram user ids allowed to talk to the bot, separated by commas; `pikit configure` fills it when you message the bot.

environment.name: TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET
environment.description: What Telegram sends with every update, so only Telegram reaches your agent; `pikit configure` generates it, and `pikit up` gives it to Telegram.
